data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin word 'Helianus', meaning 'sun of God'. In Christian tradition, the name Eliano is associated with the sun and represents God's divine light. The name Eliano carries the meaning “God's sun” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Eliano usually hope their child will grow to embody god's sun and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Eliano total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

data.cultural_impact: The name Eliano carries a rich cultural heritage rooted in Latin origins. It was popular during the Roman era and gained prominence among early Christians when Saint Elianus, a well-known martyr, was named thus. Today, this name is cherished among various Christian communities and continues to be passed down through generations as a mark of respect for the long history and significance of Christian tradition.
